question: Which divine figures preside at the place called Mūlikā and at Mahendra?
premises: Mūlikākhye names the first sacred site.
Viṣṇur is the presiding deity there.
Mahendre names the second sacred site.
Bhārgavas is the presiding figure there.
inference: Viṣṇu presides at Mūlikā and Bhārgava presides at Mahendra.
plain_english: Likewise, at the place called Mūlikā is Viṣṇu, and at Mahendra is Bhārgava.
